source_note: Keeper Rulebook percentile bonus and penalty dice use one units die plus extra tens dice; bonus selects the lowest tens digit and penalty selects the highest tens digit.

maximum_dice_per_roll.source_note: Keeper Rulebook p.91 (Bonus and Penalty Dice): after cancellation, no more than two bonus dice or two penalty dice apply to one roll. The kernel caps the net count; a Keeper who asks for more gets the capped count in the receipt, never an extra die.
